report.model_summary: Numerator genuinely grew from 144 to 179 November 2009 paid claims as late claims adjudicated, which should have raised the rate from 178.7 to 222.1 per 1,000 member-years (+43.4). The enrollment rebuild added pharmacy coverage rows (8,032 extra), inflating reported member-months from 9,670 to 17,702 and depressing the reported rate to 121.3 per 1,000 (-57.4 reported, -100.8 error).
